reviews.title: Newer optimizer history retains scenario risk-policy snapshots
reviews.finding: A connected cloud history audit found newer Calculate Investment records with candidate-level planSnapshot and phase riskProfiles; earlier retained entries lack those fields. Optimizer entries still have no per-account sample trace, so an individual risk-blocking event or funded-stage closure cannot be reconstructed from those summaries.
reviews.suggestion: Run Full Simulation for the selected model, then confirm a new cloud history record contains firms' risk, caps and sampled account traces before diagnosing an individual account.
measurements: Share of retained optimizer records containing candidate-level planSnapshot
Count of new full-simulation cloud records with sampled account traces
Per-phase risk-policy completeness and trace event counts
reviews.action: Research-only update; preserved existing records and risk settings.
reviews.source: Connected private cloud record structure (aggregated existence checks only); GitHub portfolio-history.js serializer inspection
reviews.verified: Cloud record types and field presence verified; full-simulation persistence, account-level cause and production UI remain unverified.

reviews.title: Funded-stage risk concerns need event-level diagnosis
reviews.finding: The cloud review log retains an unresolved qualitative funded-risk question. An older RR question had been categorized as general risk, but current source code routes explicit RR wording to the dedicated RR topic. No sampled trade trace was present to establish whether funded risk was excessive, correctly policy-blocked, or breached a drawdown limit.
reviews.suggestion: Use a fresh full-simulation saved trace to examine funded-stage selected tier, effective dynamic risk, residual overall/daily headroom and event closure reasons. Compare risk blocks with actual breaches; request approval before any change to risk sizing.
measurements: Explicit RR prompts routed to dedicated topic
Funded trace events: selected risk, allowed headroom, risk block versus failed status
Same-input baseline versus candidate comparison only after suitable traces exist
reviews.action: Research-only finding; no trading-risk parameters or engine rules changed.
reviews.source: Connected Results Advisor review status and GitHub portfolio-payout-ui.js topic routing plus portfolio-engine.js risk preflight
reviews.verified: Current topic-routing source inspection and cloud question status verified; source does not establish earlier routing version, and browser/cloud full-simulation trace is absent.

reviews.title: Full account-level reviews need traceable simulation evidence
reviews.finding: Stored optimizer summaries provide aggregate scenarios and risk-tier values, but legacy history does not retain the complete risk-policy snapshot or sampled account trade/closure events. Therefore an individual account's exact blocking trigger cannot be established from optimizer summaries alone.
reviews.suggestion: Analyze the chosen investment model through Run Full Simulation and verify that the saved history includes risk-policy snapshots and sampled trade events. Compare preflight risk, remaining overall and daily loss allowance, risk-blocked status and genuine loss-limit breaches.
measurements: Presence of model plan and phase-specific R1/R2/R3 policy in saved history
Number of sampled account events available
Count of actual drawdown breaches separately from risk-tier blocks
Changes in payout probabilities and blocked counts when risk is reduced at fixed budget
reviews.action: Added an evidence-readiness checker to Section 11 and expanded future history records. Older saved records cannot be automatically backfilled.
reviews.source: Connected simulation-history schema inspection and GitHub simulator/serialization code review
reviews.verified: Source records and JavaScript syntax inspected. End-to-end browser deployment and new-format cloud write not yet independently verified.

reviews.title: Risk-blocked accounts are not firm breaches
reviews.finding: The engine preflights the next configured risk against the remaining overall and daily loss allowance. If the policy cannot take that risk, the account can be removed from simulation routing without an actual loss-limit breach.
reviews.suggestion: Compare lower-risk models at the same budget, trading horizon and paired signal seed. Review per-account closure reasons and remaining headroom before changing strategy settings.
measurements: Compare cumulative risk-blocked versus breached accounts
Compare expected net, payouts, and downside at equal budget
reviews.action: Improved Account Journey closure reasons and added fixed-budget Compare Lower Risk.
reviews.source: GitHub engine code review; deterministic smoke tests
reviews.verified: Code and deterministic test only; live deployment and real performance unverified
